title: Medical Assistance Patient Pay Amount for a Month Paid from Resident Funds
content:
For the standing Medicaid patient pay transfer from a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account, the **month's patient pay amount** of the named month follows the patient pay charge and the County Assistance Office notice on the resident's case under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage:

| Charge and notice | Month's patient pay amount |
|---|---|
| the charge was billed as a partial month | the lesser of the case's patient pay and the charge's days in the center times the case's Medicaid daily rate |
| the case's patient pay takes effect on or before the first day of the named month | the case's patient pay |
| otherwise | the charge as billed |

The first row that fits decides.

## Hypothetical illustration

Case's patient pay $1046.18; case's Medicaid daily rate $289.40.

| Named charge | Patient pay effective | Month's patient pay amount |
|---|---|---|
| partial month, 11 days in the center | any date | $1046.18 (11 days times $289.40 is $3183.40) |
| partial month, 3 days in the center | any date | $868.20 (3 days times $289.40) |
| full month of March, billed $1210.00 | 1 March | $1046.18 |
| full month of March, billed $1210.00 | 1 April | $1210.00 |
